title: nuclear-quartet
description: The four canonical sub-algebras determined by two commuting nuclei on a Heyting algebra - the free carrier, the two individual fixed-point algebras, and their joint fixed point - forming an exhaustive commuting square of inclusions; the single diamond sitting at each grade of the bigraded diamond.

carrier.description: A, the free carrier: the Heyting algebra on which neither nucleus has acted

j1.description: the first nucleus j_1, a knowledge- or truth-order closure

j2.description: the second nucleus j_2, the other closure

fixJ1.description: Fix(j_1), the j_1-stable sub-algebra: all j_1-closure applied

fixJ2.description: Fix(j_2), the j_2-stable sub-algebra: all j_2-closure applied

jointFixed.description: A* = Fix(pi) = Fix(j_1) cap Fix(j_2), the doubly stable corner where both nuclei act as identity

commuting.description: j_1 . j_2 = j_2 . j_1, so the composite pi := j_1 . j_2 is itself a nucleus and the intersection becomes a canonical fixed-point sub-algebra

exhaustive.description: the four corners exhaust the canonical options: apply neither (A), j_1 alone, j_2 alone, or both (A*) - the same four-corner shape met at the articulation phases and the bilattice charge
